scope: Review of 42 new-name candidates and 43 composite source rows against the recorded 1,038 road-name baseline. Associations remain proposals, not verified physical road identities, full-road coverage or merged task statuses.
method: OpenCC simplified names and removal of trailing page-title disambiguation only for exact name matching.
Enumerated parenthetical groups expanded literally; single-item parentheses interpreted as optional text but flagged for confirmation.
No fuzzy edit-distance matches automatically accepted; close names alone are insufficient alias evidence.
Ground-road ranges under elevated or ring-system names retained separately; no equivalence with elevated/highway records.
Districts copied only from the official row; missing districts remain empty.
Group extents remain attached to original source rows; not assigned as full extent of every split target.
